name: StatedBot0
source:
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DefectBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Program
open PD
namespace PD.Bots
def StatedBot0 (k : Nat) : Prog := .search k (.plays .opp .self Action.C) (.search (2 * k + 64) (.plays .opp (.bot DefectBot) Action.D) (.const Action.C) (.const Action.D)) (.const Action.D)
end PD.Bots
